svg.desc: The position tensor has shape three by five by two. Differencing time leaves three by four by two velocity components; taking the last-axis norm gives three by four magnitudes of average velocity. These are not average path speeds when unobserved motion curves or reverses. Only trial three, interval two to three seconds, exceeds two millimeters per second; equality does not flag trial two.
svg.title: A trial-by-interval speed array
